questions.q: Which HTTP method is used to read data without modifying it?
What does the Accept: application/json header do on a request to Oracle Fusion's REST API?
options: It tells Fusion to respond in JSON format
It is required only for DELETE requests
questions.explain: The Accept header tells the server what response format the caller wants.

questions.q: In a typical Oracle Fusion list response, where do the actual records live?
questions.explain: The items array holds the actual records returned.

questions.q: If a response has "hasMore": true, what does that tell you?
options: There are more records beyond the current page that weren't returned
questions.explain: hasMore indicates additional records exist beyond the current page.

questions.q: What are the three pieces every HTTP request is made of?
questions.explain: Every HTTP request consists of a method, a URL, and headers.
